page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8a.xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 4 dedicated physical cores on an x86_64 AMD EPYC 9T24 processor running at a base clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The instance is configured with 16.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or bundled GPUs, and it operates with a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks reveal strong single-core CPU capabilities, with stress-ng single-core testing placing the instance in the top 25% of its class. However, multi-core and multi-threaded scaling present some limitations. The stress-ng multi-core CPU performance and PassMark CPU score fall within the average range, while multi-threaded bzip3 decompression and PassMark database operations register in the bottom 25%. Cryptographic execution is supported by hardware-accelerated instruction sets like AES and SHA_NI, yielding average results in PassMark encryption tests.

The lack of local storage requires reliance on external network-attached storage, which, combined with a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps, may constrain high-throughput I/O workloads. This limitation is reflected in the weak static web serving throughput and lower Redis SET operations. Consequently, the instance is best suited for general-purpose workloads such as lightweight application servers, development environments, and moderate computational tasks that benefit from dedicated CPU allocation but do not demand intensive multi-threaded scaling or high-speed local storage.
